summary.text: Joseph Dailey is a Republican candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 11 (2 seats) in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Republican primary on July 21, 2026.
He is also on the November ballot for the Phoenix Union High School District, Ward 2, and works as a business executive, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Joseph Dailey was born in Ohio and earned a bachelor's degree from Youngstown State University in 1995 and a graduate degree from Arizona State University in 1999, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a business executive, and Ballotpedia lists U.S. Navy service.
